articles.headline: Tatum scores 32, Celtics set franchise history on the way to 131-94 rout of Mavericks
articles.description: — Jayson Tatum scored 32 points in 30 minutes on a night the Boston Celtics set a franchise record for its lead at the end of the opening period on the way to a 131-94 win over the Dallas Mavericks on Sunday night.

articles.headline: Spurs win 12th straight while sending Jazz to 12th straight loss
articles.description: — Dylan Harper had 31 points and nine rebounds to rally the San Antonio Spurs to a 110-102 victory over the Utah Jazz on Sunday, giving them their 12th straight win, while sending the Jazz to a 12th straight loss.
